Its sturdy construction makes it a timeless addition to your holiday décor.</p><p><strong>Features:</strong></p><ul><li>6ft (1.8m) tall – perfect for medium-sized spaces.</li><li>Realistic PE &amp; PVC branches for natural texture and fullness.</li><li>Hinged branches for effortless setup and storage.</li><li>Full and symmetrical design for classic appeal.</li><li>Sturdy frame for stability and long-term use.</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
Celebrate the season with the beautifully crafted 6ft (1.8m) Lapland Spruce Christmas Tree, featuring a premium blend of PE and PVC branches for a lifelike look and feel. The hinged branch design ensures quick and easy assembly, while the combination of materials delivers realistic texture and fullness. Standing at 6ft (1.8m), this spruce offers a full silhouette perfect for showcasing your favorite decorations. Its sturdy construction makes it a timeless addition to your holiday décor.

Features:
• 6ft (1.8m) tall – perfect for medium-sized spaces.
• Realistic PE & PVC branches for natural texture and fullness.
• Hinged branches for effortless setup and storage.
• Full and symmetrical design for classic appeal.
• Sturdy frame for stability and long-term use.
